Name: Ladder Module
Description:
An inbuilt ladder for traversing vertically between storeys.

Attaches directly to corridors.

Name: Exterior Platform
Description:
An unsheltered observation deck. Allows the user to step outside an orbital construction, and gaze directly into the vastness of space.

A Reinforced Door must be installed to allow access to exterior spaces.

Name: Exterior Catwalk
Description:
This exterior walkway intelligently adjoins to existing rooms, creating decking outside orbital constructions.

A Reinforced Door must be installed to allow access to exterior spaces.

Name: Reinforced Door
Description:
A thick, robust door.

Hermetically sealed for installation in orbital constructions, or between internal corridors and rooms.

Name: Reinforced Window
Description:
A pane of low thermal expansion glass.

Can be fitted into orbital constructions to open up a view into space.

Name: Internal Wall
Description: An interior wall to subdivide large habitable spaces. Seamlessly configures itself to fit the aesthetics of the surrounding room.

Name: Galactic Trade Room
Description:
Integrated equipment providing instant local access to the galactic trade market for resources and commodities.

This module is placed as an entire room and comes with its functional units pre-installed.

Name: Teleport Chamber
Description:
This personal teleport device allows the user to move quickly between their freighter, bases, as well as any Space Station Terminuses connected to their network. User is urged to verify network integrity before inserting any matter they cannot afford to become separated from.

This module is placed as an entire room and comes with its functional units pre-installed.

Name: Appearance Modifier Room
Description:
Integrated equipment allowing the user to adjust their personal appearance settings. This module is placed as an entire room and comes with its functional units pre-installed.

The module applies advanced holographic techniques to recalibrate the light around the user, allowing them to adopt whatever appearance they desire. Visual data must be properly formatted before use.

Name: Technology Room (expansion)
Description: A spacious chamber with a technical aesthetic, for expanding habitable spaces inside orbital constructions.

Name: Cultivation Chamber
Description:
A temperature controlled bio-room. A bed of nutrient-rich soil provides ideal conditions for cultivating agricultural crops.

This module is placed as an entire room and comes with its functional units pre-installed.

Name: Double Cultivation Chamber
Description:
A temperature controlled bio-room. Two beds of nutrient-rich soil provide ideal conditions for cultivating agricultural crops.

This module is placed as an entire room and comes with its functional units pre-installed.

Name: Nutrition Room
Description:
An integrated Nutrient Processor module, able to refine gathered ingredients into edible food products. This module is placed as an entire room and comes with its functional units pre-installed.

User is advised that consumption of generated products is entirely at their own risk.

Name: Biological Room (expansion)
Description: This spacious greenhouse chamber naturally filters and oxygenates the air supply, and offers a little sanctuary of green in freighter habitation.

Name: Refiner Room
Description:
The Refiner Room allows three different substances to be processed into more powerful and more advanced materials.

This module is placed as an entire room and comes with its functional units pre-installed.

Name: Stellar Extractor Room
Description:
Gathers resources directly from the interstellar medium, via a complex system of suction intakes and condensing tubes. The gathered substance varies with the local star classification.

This module is placed as an entire room and comes with its functional units pre-installed.

Name: Science Terminal
Description: A research station tailored to the needs of Scientists, and equipped for research and development of scientific blueprints.

Name: Weapons Terminal
Description: A research station tailored to the needs of Armourers, and equipped for the development of munitions and explosives as well as selected civilian tech.

Name: Agricultural Terminal
Description: A research station tailored to the needs of Farmers, and equipped for the analysis and cultivation of farmable crops.

Name: Exocraft Terminal
Description: A research station tailored to the needs of Technicians, and equipped with bespoke vehicular design software.

Name: Construction Terminal
Description: A research station tailored to the needs of Construction Overseers, and equipped with architectural and engineering design software.

Name: Storage Room
Description:
Hybrid high-capacity storage unit / shelving module for installation in orbital constructions. This module is placed as an entire room and comes with its functional units pre-installed.

Inventory capacity interfaces directly with planetary Storage Containers, and the module may be renamed for ease of identification.
